newsitem.title: USA: White House confirms to submit FY 98 budget Feb 6.
newsitem.headline: White House confirms to submit FY 98 budget Feb 6.

text.p: The White House on Wednesday confirmed that it will submit its fiscal 1998 budget proposal to Congress on Feb. 6.

"We will submit the budget on the sixth," said a White House spokeswoman, confirming a joint statement issued earlier by Republican leaders, House Speaker Newt Gingrich and Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott.

By law the budget must be sent to Congress by the first Monday in February, which this year falls on Feb. 3. However, the White House said earlier this week it wanted to delay the submission until after President Bill Clinton gives his State of the Union Address, which has been scheduled for Feb. 4.
